name: Lord of Imagination
source:
Your life hasn't been a success since you left the high school. You are bouncing from one work to another trying to make some money, you don't have a lot of friends and you are generally pretty sad with how things turned out, but you are trying your best to make something out of it. Your father suddenly disappeared in your childhood, which doesn't help at all. At least you have a supportive girlfriend which you are glad about. You wonder what would happen if you had the power to make all the wishes come true... And there comes an opportunity, but at what cost? Will you do what it takes to fulfill your dreams or fight it to save your family?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/agentgames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
自高中毕业后，你的人生一直不太顺利。你为了赚钱辗转于不同工作之间，朋友不多，对现状也大多感到沮丧，但仍尽力让生活有所起色。父亲在你童年时突然失踪，这件事更让一切雪上加霜。至少，你还有一位支持自己的女友，对此你心怀感激。你不禁想，如果能拥有实现所有愿望的力量，会怎么样……机会真的来了，可代价是什么？你会不惜一切实现梦想，还是为了拯救家人与之抗争？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/agentgames]Patreon[/url]]
